limitations: Cases are newly authored by the implementer; heldout partition was not used to tune live models but is not an independent external assessment.
Provider is a deterministic adversarial double; results measure host controls, not real-model attack resistance.
Repeated deterministic cases are not independent security samples; intervals are descriptive.
Baseline arm is the same protected graph with explicitly disabled controls in a separate benchmark process; it is not the historical Chatbot-USMS application.
